verdict.rationale: OpenHands supports running agents locally, in Docker, on VMs, or via an agent server backend, and offers Apptainer as a container runtime for sandboxed execution in restricted environments, implying isolated code execution. However, there is no explicit documentation on dependency installation workflows, sandbox security guarantees, or hands-on verification of isolation robustness. Missing for 10: explicit sandbox security model/documentation, dependency installation details, independent verification of isolation.
